encounter: E0144 Gerald (Lavaridge Gym room 2) cap36 - attempt 3, speed-and-redirection
availability_audit: Chronology: every source map precedes Jagged Pass in book play order (Route 101-104, 111, 116, 117, Petalburg Woods, Granite Cave, Rusturf Tunnel, Seaspray Cave, Mauville Game Corner). Togepi Route102 land g14 -> friendship Togetic -> Shiny Stone Togekiss g24. Squirtle Mauville Game Corner 500 coins g30 -> Wartortle -> Blastoise g36; Blastoisinite stone-window=14, base-window=36, Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly. Marill Petalburg City old_rod g14 -> Azumarill g20. Swinub Seaspray_Cave_B1F land g14 -> Piloswine -> Mamoswine known-move g36. Abra GraniteCave_1F g20 -> Kadabra -> Alakazam Linking Cord g20. Drilbur RusturfTunnel land g20 -> Excadrill level g36. No legendaries, mythicals, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species; single Mega slot. Ordinary held items from the free Center held-item catalogue.
plan: Attempts 1 and 2 both lost 6-2 and the same Pokemon decided both: Life Orb Chlorophyll Victreebel. In sun it outruns everything, Solar Beam is a one-turn move at 2x into Water and Ground, and Sludge Bomb is 2x into Grass and Fairy - between them it one-shot a full-HP Mega Blastoise, a full-HP Thick Fat Mamoswine, a full-HP Ludicolo and a full-HP Togekiss across the two attempts. Attempt 2's rain answer failed because Volbeat's Prankster Sunny Day overwrites Drizzle with priority every single turn it is alive. Attempt 3 stops trying to win the weather war and instead answers Victreebel directly: Alakazam's Psychic is 2x into its Poison typing and its Focus Sash guarantees it survives to fire even going second, while Togekiss' Follow Me pulls Victreebel's single-target attacks onto the one body that resists Solar Beam. Tailwind is the backup speed answer if the first exchange goes badly. No new species and no items the earlier attempts did not already have - this is a reordering plus a target-selection plan, not a power increase.
